title: Source Contract Depth SLA Credit Demonstration Slice
pii_phi_handling: Synthetic, PHI-free, planning-grade Source contract-depth slice. No patient, member, provider, claim-line, PHI, PII, or real production client records are included. Financial values are demonstration inputs and must not be treated as finance-confirmed realized value.
notes: Manifest gates the governed ACA Job load for one contract-depth demonstration slice: 12 monthly spend rows, 12 monthly performance rows, 3 service-credit rows, and one persisted optimization opportunity. It does not activate a production client claim or realized-value assertion.
